properties.wire_type: LAN JSON empty string despite a readable alternate numeric descriptor
properties.transform/range: Original descriptor36 reads raw uint8 at offset91 and command emits its low byte in UART TLV 5b/01. The network name/string serializer does not expose that numeric getter: actual command/res/status/dat replay returns empty-string LAN readouts in both source cache banks.
properties.ack_vs_stored: These V16/V20/V30 builds retain opt ExWdSpd with empty-string p/val. V7/BV9 omit this unknown-network-name slot entirely. Original UART TLV and numeric getter remain separate evidence; no physical fan-speed calibration or board acceptance inferred.

evidence.scope: Exact original table/getter/command control flow; no claim of a separately executed ExWdSpd LAN poll.

All10 exact AV/BV original images, both numeric banks, literal UART TLV, real res/status/dat, duplicate/mixed slots and modern activation0/1/2/3; 212 vectors executed. Exact requested256/raw0 wrapping leaves LAN strings empty.

route_variants.route: alternate MID classification incl6079; each exact build independently decoded
route_variants.transform: Raw uint8/LE16 descriptor cache followed by exact special inverse; indexed fields use native param3. No inferred temperature calibration.
route_variants.ack_vs_stored: These V16/V20/V30 builds retain opt ExWdSpd with empty-string p/val. V7/BV9 omit this unknown-network-name slot entirely. Original UART TLV and numeric getter remain separate evidence; no physical fan-speed calibration or board acceptance inferred.
route_variants.write_transform: Selector1/34/35 uses exact per-build alternate converter; remaining admitted raw fields store directly into byte/LE16/bit descriptor stage. Not physical actuator acceptance.
route_variants.cache_default: Chosen raw zero-filled synthetic cache; Pow encoded0x55. Reset restores defaults; modeled reports update actual bank, commands stage separate bank. No physical calibration or actuator claim.
